value: Tangram Flex offers Tangram Pro, a comprehensive software integration platform designed to help the Department of Defense (DoD) modernize and connect systems across all domains. This intuitive solution streamlines complex challenges by enabling collaborative design, expediting system architecture, auto-generating integration code, and verifying component behavior before deployment. Tangram Pro ensures secure, safe, and rapid software integration, interoperability, and DevSecOps, empowering DoD teams to confidently update mission-critical and legacy systems, continuously adapt to evolving requirements, and ultimately enhance the safety and effectiveness of warfighter software.
